why: The pilot, 2026-10-25: raise DeckCheck's DTI from 41 by fixing the weaknesses found after game 003 and DeckCheck's roast. One clean answer in the 99 (Swords), one counterspell (Negate), nothing for an enchantment, a planeswalker (Narset, Parter of Veils shuts off the wheels) or a graveyard; three basics, all Mountains, with red and white short of their land targets (engine.json mana stage R34/U23/W19 vs R36/U22/W22). Forge read the cost of the voltron merge: interaction cast per game 0.376 -> 0.167, [-0.287, -0.132], olivers-table. Objective: get it back. The DTI is the pilot's aim and is never the grade.

objective.why: The pilot, 2026-10-25: Purphoros taken out of Oliver's table (as a stand-in it won 25 of 40 in run c0f7e15a and dealt 70.5 noncombat damage a game, eliminating sharknado 18 times), so the objective moves to olivers-table-3p. The 0.38 level came from the four-player table and is revisited against the v2.0.0 baseline on the new one.

commits.message: Ten swaps for the holes found after game 003 and DeckCheck's roast: Get Lost, Chaos Warp, Izzet Charm, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat (answers and protection); Wheel of Fortune for Khorvath's Fury; Lotus Petal and Mystic Remora; Otawara and Hallowed Fountain for two lands that make no colour on time. Restaged from twelve: Force of Negation and Refute (1UU) left the deck eight blue sources short, and cutting Chasm Skulker and Blade Historian cost the keep rule its bodies.

summary.title: Answers for the holes: enchantments, planeswalkers, graveyards, a second counter
summary.blurb: Swap a few soft slots for real interaction — any-permanent removal, an enchantment and planeswalker answer, graveyard hate and a looting counterspell — so the deck can stop a Narset or a stuck board, and fix the all-Mountain basics.

staged.why: Real removal for a creature, enchantment or planeswalker (Narset); Iroh's is sorcery-speed and DeckCheck's weakest slot.
Counter, 2 damage or a loot that pays both commanders; Glove cost 3 + equip 3 and no proven stack used it.
Free with a commander out: protect the commander instead of recasting it under tax.
The same discard wheel two mana cheaper; still pays Brallin.
Fast mana toward an earlier commander (Shabraz out by T4 in 0.412 of goldfish games).
A one-mana draw engine; every draw is a Shabraz counter.
An untapped land with a bounce channel, for an always-tapped one.
Untapped W/U fixing for a land that makes no colour on its own.
A one-mana counter for noncreature spells; single U keeps blue on target (Force of Negation and Refute at 1UU pushed the blue target 22 -> 36, eight sources short).
